sections.content: Contains 50% more calcium than dairy milk, crafted from Blue Diamond almonds, free from artificial flavors, gluten, carrageenan, and MSG, and backed by a money-back taste guarantee.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Almond Breeze is a brand of almond milk, crafted from Blue Diamond almonds, offering a delicious and nutritious alternative to dairy milk. It provides more calcium than dairy milk and is free from artificial flavors, gluten, carrageenan, and MSG, fitting naturally into everyday routines.
